{{Quote|Oz is down.''"<br />"''So is Ringo.|Two clone troopers, upon checking Ringo and Oz after an explosion|<ref name="DOU" />}}
'''Ringo''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Ringo was part of [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]], a [[Company/Legends|unit]] within the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]. During the war Ringo and Torrent Company were sent to [[Battle of Ereesus|defend]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ereesus]] after it was invaded by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Ringo and the 501st, alongside other Republic [[Battle group|battlegroups]], [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]]. Immediately after landing, the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were attacked by the native [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbarans]]. Making their way to the [[Umbaran capital city/Legends|Umbaran capital city]], Ringo and the 501st had to take a road that had been [[Mine/Legends|mined]] by the Umbarans. Ringo and another [[Troop/Legends|trooper]], [[Oz/Legends|Oz]], stepped on a mine, and they were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the following explosion.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Three squads to the ridge. Left taking point, right carrying EMP grenades.''"<br />"''Got it dead to rights, Captain.|Sollaw ap-Orwien and Ringo|<ref name="Speaking Silently" />}}
[[File:Epguide407.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Republic forces on Umbara]]
[[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] and raised on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] as a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="clone troopers" /> the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who took the name Ringo served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="DOU" /> Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Ringo was a member of [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]],<ref name="Speaking Silently" /> a [[Company/Legends|unit]] within the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], which was commanded by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]<ref name="DOU" /> and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], nicknamed "Rex." Around the same [[Time/Legends|time]], Ringo and Torrent Company were dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ereesus]]. There, the clones [[Battle of Ereesus|assisted]] the [[Ereesus Planetary Security Forces]] in defending the world against a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] invasion. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] soon suffered a major setback, however, when a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of local [[Troop/Legends|troops]] and their clone [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] liaison, [[Oz/Legends|Oz]], were captured by the Separatists.<ref name="Speaking Silently" />

Ringo and fellow trooper [[Jesse/Legends|Jesse]] joined [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Rex and local militiamen [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sollaw ap-Orwien]] and [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Dafyd]] at the Republic's forward operating base, where ap-Orwien ascertained several key pieces of intelligence simply by watching a Separatist [[Hologram/Legends|holorecording]] of the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], including [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Palola]]&mdash;as they were both [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdians]], ap-Orwien was able to interpret Palola's [[Kinetic communication|subtle mimics]] of [[Language/Legends|communication]], which went unnoticed by [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] captors. To verify his ability for the clones, ap-Orwien left the room while Rex gave Ringo and Jesse hypothetical orders as a test of the Lorrdians. Upon returning, ap-Orwien was able to obtain the orders from Dafyd, who had stayed in the room with the clones and overheard Rex's commands, without the two of them speaking. With the intelligence learned from Palola, Rex assembled a team that included Ringo to rescue the captured squad. Upon arriving at the Separatist facility where the [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] were being held, Ringo and Jesse used explosives to open the main doors. The team fought off several [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] and successfully rescued the captured squad. Ringo and the others also took the cranial unit of a [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] before returning to base.<ref name="Speaking Silently" />

Sometime during the war, the 501st was dispatched to [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|reclaim]] the former Republic-allied planet [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]]. After landing on the surface of Umbara, Ringo and the 501st immediately engaged the native [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbarans]], who had aligned themselves with the Separatists. Although the clone troopers took heavy casualties in the engagement, Ringo and his brothers secured a landing zone for the Republic troops. However, shortly afterward, Skywalker was recalled to the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and replaced by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]],<ref name="DOU" /> a [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] known for the high casualty rates of clone troopers under his command.<ref name="SWEKrell">{{SWE|characters|generalpongkrell|General Pong Krell}}</ref>

Krell overrode Skywalker's original plan to capture the [[Umbaran capital city/Legends|Umbaran capital]] by ordering Ringo and the 501st to stage a full frontal assault on the heavily fortified [[City/Legends|city]]. Finding the main road&mdash;the fastest way to the city&mdash;Ringo and his comrades were ordered to proceed toward the capital. However, unbeknownst to the clones, the Umbarans had [[Mine/Legends|mined]] the road. Ringo and fellow trooper Oz stepped on one such mine and were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the resulting explosion.<ref name="DOU" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Do Jesse next.|Ringo, after Sollaw ap-Orwien imitated Captain Rex|<ref name="Speaking Silently" />}}
Ringo was impressed when Sollaw ap-Orwien was able to learn just by communicating silently with Dafyd all the orders that Rex and given to he and Jesse as a test of the Lorrdians' speechless language. Ringo was also the first clone to laugh over ap-Orwien's imitation of Captain Rex.<ref name="Speaking Silently" /> While serving on Umbara, Ringo was unable to detect a mine on a road, which resulted in his death when he stepped on it.<ref name="DOU" /> Like his clone imprint, Ringo stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="clone troopers" />

==Equipment==
During the Umbaran battle, Ringo donned [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] with the [[Color/Legends|blue]] markings of his unit, the 501st Legion.<ref name="DOU" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ringo served as a minor character in "[[Darkness on Umbara]]," the seventh episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="Explore: Darkness on Umbara">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/darkness-on-umbara-episode-guide|text="Darkness on Umbara" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> "Darkness on Umbara" aired on [[October 28]], [[2011]].<ref name="Insider 129: Launch Pad">{{InsiderCite|129|Launchpad}}</ref> He was also mentioned in the episode's corresponding [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|online guide]] on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Explore: Darkness on Umbara" /> In [[2013]], Ringo was featured in ''[[Speaking Silently]]'', a short story written by [[Tom Hodges]] and published in [[Star Wars Insider 139|''Star Wars Insider'' 139]].<ref name="Speaking Silently" />
